description: Implement the admin panel MVC controllers and Thymeleaf templates for edit-only persistent management, plus the inventory consistency validator. This covers Tasks 7 and 8 from the plan: AdminPanelController with restricted edit-only operations, Thymeleaf templates listing installations and green areas, and the MapInventoryRegistry/MapInventoryValidator for environment-aware consistency checking.
steps: Create src/main/java/app/service/MapInventoryRegistry.java: @Service that loads and parses src/main/resources/map/map-locations.json at startup. Provides methods: getAllEntries(), getByMapKey(String), getByGlbObjectName(String), getInstallationEntries(), getGreenAreaEntries(). Uses Jackson ObjectMapper to read the JSON.

Create src/main/java/app/service/MapInventoryValidator.java: @Component that runs on ApplicationReadyEvent. Compares registry entries against database records. Checks: every registry mapKey exists in DB, every registry glbObjectName matches DB, locationType matches, subtype detail record exists, no extra active DB records beyond registry. In dev/test profile: logs warnings for mismatches but does not fail. In prod profile: throws an exception to prevent startup if any mismatch found. Use @Value or @ConfigurationProperties for mode control.
Create src/main/resources/application.properties entry: app.inventory.validation-mode=warn (default for dev).

Create src/main/java/app/controller/mvc/AdminPanelController.java: replaces the concept of the old one. Routes: GET /admin-panel (dashboard), GET /admin-panel/instalaciones (list all installations), GET /admin-panel/areas-verdes (list all green areas), GET /admin-panel/instalaciones/{mapKey}/edit (edit form for installation), POST /admin-panel/instalaciones/{mapKey}/edit (process edit), GET /admin-panel/areas-verdes/{mapKey}/edit (edit form for green area), POST /admin-panel/areas-verdes/{mapKey}/edit (process edit). No add or delete routes. Uses constructor injection with InstalacionService, AreaVerdeService, MapLocationQueryService.
Create src/main/java/app/controller/mvc/PageController.java: serves GET / (redirect to map) and GET /mapa (the 3D map page using mapa.html template).
Create src/main/resources/templates/admin_panel.html: Thymeleaf layout with sidebar navigation. Dashboard showing counts of installations and green areas.

Create src/main/resources/templates/admin/instalaciones.html: table listing all installations with columns: mapKey (read-only), displayName, facilityType, operationalStatus, and an Edit link. No add/delete buttons.
Create src/main/resources/templates/admin/areas-verdes.html: table listing all green areas with columns: mapKey (read-only), displayName, sector, surfaceArea, and an Edit link. No add/delete buttons.

Create src/main/resources/templates/admin/edit-instalacion.html: edit form showing mapKey and glbObjectName as read-only fields, editable fields: displayName (required), description, useDescription, academicPrograms, floorCount, operationalStatus dropdown. Shows validation error messages. Submit posts to the same URL.

Create src/main/resources/templates/admin/edit-area-verde.html: edit form showing mapKey and glbObjectName as read-only, editable fields: displayName (required), description, sector, surfaceArea. Shows validation error messages.
Create src/main/resources/templates/fragments/admin-sidebar.html: Thymeleaf fragment with navigation links to dashboard, instalaciones, and areas-verdes sections.
Create src/main/resources/templates/mapa.html: page that includes the Three.js libraries and mapa.js for the 3D map.
acceptance_criteria: MapInventoryRegistry loads all 54 entries from map-locations.json at startup
MapInventoryValidator in dev mode logs warnings but allows startup with mismatches
MapInventoryValidator in prod mode throws exception on mismatch preventing startup
Admin panel has NO add or delete routes - only list and edit
Edit forms display mapKey and glbObjectName as read-only text (not editable inputs)
Edit forms show Bean Validation errors when submitted with invalid data
Admin instalaciones route uses mapKey in URL, not numeric ID
Admin areas-verdes route uses mapKey in URL, not numeric ID
verification: Read AdminPanelController to confirm no add/delete handler methods exist
Read templates to confirm no add/delete buttons or forms exist
Read MapInventoryValidator to confirm profile-based behavior switching
Verify all controller methods use mapKey path variable, not numeric ID
findings: All 13 files created/modified successfully. No compilation possible due to INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode. Structural verification confirms: no add/delete routes in AdminPanelController, all routes use mapKey path variable, edit forms display mapKey/glbObjectName as read-only plain text (div elements), MapInventoryValidator uses @Value for validation-mode with warn default and fail in prod, MapInventoryRegistry uses Jackson ObjectMapper to parse classpath resource. Controllers use constructor injection exclusively.
